messages:
marta: quick question — I'm investigating intermittent tail latency spikes on eu-dedicated-pool-4. Where's the single-pane view for per-pool queued_requests and cpu-steal so I can correlate with request p95? The current pool-saturation alert fired a bunch last night and I want to tune before the next oncall.
ben: try the per-pool dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pools/per-pool-overview?var-pool=eu-dedicated-pool-4 :eyes: it has panels for queued requests, pod cpu%, and node steal. For logs use Kibana -> Logs -> query: kubernetes.labels.pool: "eu-dedicated-pool-4". Also see the autoscale graph at /d/pools/autoscale?var-pool=eu-dedicated-pool-4
sam: prometheus snippets that helped me last time:

```
# avg queued requests over 5m
avg_over_time(dedicated_pool_queue_length{pool="eu-dedicated-pool-4"}[5m])

# p95 request latency
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{pool="eu-dedicated-pool-4"}[5m])) by (le))

# per-pool cpu-steal (node-level metric aggregated to pool)
sum(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="steal", pool="eu-dedicated-pool-4"}) by (instance)
```

sam: if you want a quick pod-level snapshot:
`kubectl top pods -n dedicated --selector=pool=eu-dedicated-pool-4 --no-headers | sort -k3 -nr | head`
karim: fwiw the alert we have today is too chatty because it's pop-on short spikes. propose: only fire if (avg queued requests over 10m) > 40 AND pool_saturation > 0.85 for 5m, with a 15m cooldown before re-alerting. Also add an annotation with a runbook link and a suppression label for planned-maintenance.
olivia: +1 to runbook + suppression. Can we also add a mitigator action to temporarily shift routing to the lower-tier backup pool when saturation > 0.9? that reduced customer impact in last incident.
ben: I can draft the alert rule. plan:
- change eval window to 10m
- require both queue > 40 (10m avg) and saturation > 0.85 (5m)
- add for: 5m (Prometheus for:) and a 15m silence after firing
- attach runbook + link to canary escalation
I'll open a small PR and tag oncall for quick review.

ben: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/infra-alerts/pulls/1023 — includes rule diff + runbook link
infra-bot: [alertmanager] new patchset pushed to PR #1023 by ben, CI: passed :white_check_mark:
marta: thanks — I'll correlate the queued_requests + p95 series against last night's spike window around 03:12-03:22 UTC and drop notes in the PR. If we see sustained steal on nodes we'll consider moving pods off the noisy instance type.
sam: one extra query you might want to chart: error_budget_burn_rate{pool="eu-dedicated-pool-4"} and pool_request_retry_rate — helps see if retries are amplifying queues.
karim: also add a label to the alert to skip during capacity-maintenance workflows: `skip_during_maintenance=true` — we have automation that sets that label when maintenance windows run.
olivia: can someone add a small dashboard panel that shows "queue vs scaled replicas" so PMs can visually understand autoscale catches up? otherwise they'll ping eng every time.
ben: noted — adding panel in PR.
infra-bot: PR #1023 merged by ben, deploy job started — https://ci.redwood.internal/teams/infra/jobs/alert-sync/305 :rocket:
marta: awesome, thanks all. I'll follow up with a quick postmortem note if I find correlated node steal artifacts. :coffee:
